title: Kyle sends whole sensory experiences telepathically

tellings.quote: sends that message to you telepathically you receive the smells and the feelings

plain: A person in England named Kyle is said to send whole experiences by telepathy, mind to mind, so that the receiver gets not just a message but the smells and feelings that come with it. Ky Dickens, the maker of a documentary about telepathy called The Telepathy Tapes, tells this on the podcast, passing on what Kyle and Kyle's mother told her. If true, it would mean thoughts can be shared as full sensory scenes, not only as words.
